title: How Much Screen Time Suits Your Child? The Rule and the Alternative
summary: The World Health Organization recommends that screen time not exceed one hour daily for children aged 2 to 5, and less is better. Excess affects sleep, language, and attention. The solution is not total prohibition but setting limits while preparing an enjoyable alternative: play, drawing, outdoor activity.
try_this: This week: Set one fixed screen time slot daily, and prepare an alternative activity ready beforehand (games or a book).
reflection_prompts: How many hours of screen time does your child actually spend today?
What alternative have you tried that worked?
